gazebo_dusk-0.speaker: narrator
gazebo_dusk-0.text: An eventful day for Sameer and Parth — the beach, the streets, and now the park, as evening settles around the gazebo.

gazebo_dusk-1.speaker: parth
gazebo_dusk-1.text: Nothing, man. Just trying to get an internship.

gazebo_dusk-2.speaker: sameer
gazebo_dusk-2.text: Same. Honestly, today was the first time I didn't think about Jade Street all day.

gazebo_talk-0.speaker: parth
gazebo_talk-0.text: You know how it goes — recruiters ghost you after making you run around.

gazebo_talk-2.speaker: sameer
gazebo_talk-2.text: Dude, I think Jade Street just ghosted me. Let me have some hope — maybe they're still deciding.

gazebo_talk-3.speaker: parth
gazebo_talk-3.text: Right. The AI reviewing your resume would take three days?

gazebo_call-0.speaker: narrator
gazebo_call-0.text: Parth's phone rings. He picks it up and listens — not a word, only a slow glance at Sameer.

gazebo_call-1.speaker: parth
gazebo_call-1.text: Alright, I gotta go. Mum's calling. Tomorrow — same time?

gazebo_call-2.speaker: narrator
gazebo_call-2.text: And then he ran off. Weird.

gazebo_call-4.speaker: narrator
gazebo_call-4.text: Parth leaves earlier than usual. Sameer walks home alone.

gazebo_nextday-0.speaker: narrator
gazebo_nextday-0.text: The next day, Sameer is back at the park. Fifteen minutes pass. Then the calls — one, two… the fifth in ten minutes. No answer.

gazebo_nextday-1.speaker: sameer
gazebo_nextday-1.text: Pick up, man. This isn't funny.

hall_mother-0.speaker: mother
hall_mother-0.text: Oh hello beta. You and Parth got bored already?

hall_mother-1.speaker: sameer
hall_mother-1.text: No, aunty — Parth didn't come at all. I came to take him with me.

hall_mother-2.speaker: mother
hall_mother-2.text: But he left home about an hour ago..?

hall_search-0.speaker: narrator
hall_search-0.text: His favourite cafe. The football stands. The library. The park again. Two, three hours of calling. Parth is nowhere to be found.

station_open-0.speaker: narrator
station_open-0.text: The police station is crowded and migraine-inducing, as all government offices are. The officer is having a masala dosa, flipping through cases with greasy fingers.

station_q1-0.speaker: mother
station_q1-0.text: My son is missing! We can't contact him. His name is Parth.

station_q1-1.speaker: officer
station_q1-1.text: How long has it been since you last saw him, ma'am?

station_q1-2.speaker: sameer
station_q1-2.text: Somewhere between two and three hours.

station_q1-3.speaker: officer
station_q1-3.text: Missing cases can only be filed after 48 hours. Have you checked his friends' homes?

station_q1-4.speaker: mother
station_q1-4.text: Yes. Everywhere we can think of.

station_q2-0.speaker: officer
station_q2-0.text: When and where did you last see him?

station_q2-2.speaker: officer
station_q2-2.text: Was there anything odd about him, when you last saw him?

station_q2-3.speaker: sameer
station_q2-3.text: He left early — after getting a call from his mother.

station_lie-0.speaker: mother
station_lie-0.text: I didn't call him. He told me you had left early.

station_lie-1.speaker: narrator
station_lie-1.text: Sameer and Parth's mother look at each other in confusion. Parth had lied to both of them. But why?

station_end-0.speaker: officer
station_end-0.text: We'll file the missing person case — but I can't give you any guarantee.

station_end-1.speaker: narrator
station_end-1.text: No clue. A dead end. They leave the station with nothing.

room_beep-0.speaker: narrator
room_beep-0.text: Sameer goes home stressed. Cold leftovers, no energy to cook. Just as he's about to sleep — a beep.

room_beep-1.speaker: narrator
room_beep-1.text: A notification from Parth. A voice note.

room_call-1.speaker: narrator
room_call-1.text: The call doesn't connect. There is nothing left to do but listen.

room_voicenote-0.speaker: voice
room_voicenote-0.text: The moon has a dark side you never see,

room_voicenote-1.speaker: voice
room_voicenote-1.text: Some secrets even light can't reach,

room_voicenote-3.speaker: voice
room_voicenote-3.text: Where he hides what he knows best.

room_voicenote-4.speaker: voice
room_voicenote-4.text: The room may hold what he never said,

room_voicenote-6.speaker: voice
room_voicenote-6.text: So tread carefully, and look behind…

room_voicenote-7.speaker: voice
room_voicenote-7.text: You may not like what you're about to find.

room_end-0.speaker: narrator
room_end-0.text: Shivers run down his spine. The voice is deep, mocking, warped — it doesn't belong to Parth.

room_end-1.speaker: sameer
room_end-1.text: Jade Street ghosted me… but you didn't. Who are you?
